newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 12.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The head office of the People's Bank of China has started to do re-discount business with head offices of four major state banks to help improve control over money supply at the national level.
- Deputies at the on-going annual session of the National People's Congress (parliament) urge a quick formulation for the Securities Law.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China's grain supply structure has fundamentally changed with the sourthern provinces beginning to buy grain from their northern counterparts.
- Many Shanghai industrial firms using their working capital poorly with only 47 percent of the firms having plans to invest their surplus capital this year.
